title: Your Profile
content: Your profile section lets you manage your personal details, review your support activity, and configure notification preferences — all in one place.

title: Open Profile
content: Click your profile card to open the profile page.

title: Basic Information
content: Here you can view and edit your name, email, phone number, and role. Keeping this up to date ensures alerts and notifications reach the right person.

title: Support Activity
content: All support tickets you've raised are tracked here — bugs, feature requests, and general queries. You can monitor their status and follow up directly from this panel.

title: Notifications
content: Control how you receive alerts. Toggle email notifications on or off here so you only get notified through the channels that work best for you.
